newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-IAMA says completes Pratco purchase.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-IAMA says completes Pratco purchase.

text.p: Rural merchandise company IAMA Ltd said on Monday it had completed the purchase of Queensland-based Pratco Industries Ltd, through its subsidiary Farmland Pty Ltd.

The purchase price, partially based on performance, would range between A$3.5 million and A$4.7 million. IAMA said Pratco, which makes blade parts, was expected to generate A$8.7 million in sales and A$800,000 profit after tax this financial year.
